# scripts/mutation-pr.sh chooses the default whole-run limit: 3600 when the diff changes a non-test Go file in internal/flow or below it, otherwise 1200.
# Only gremlins and timeout are stubs. The stub timeout writes its limit to limit.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:git] skip
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
env GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
chmod 755 fake/gremlins
chmod 755 fake/timeout
env PATH=$WORK/fake:$PATH

exec git init -q -b main repo
mkdir repo/internal/flow
mkdir repo/other/internal/flow
mkdir repo/internal/flow/sub
mkdir repo/internal/flowx
cp f.go repo/internal/flow/sub/s.go
cp f.go repo/internal/flowx/x.go
cp a.go repo/a.go
cp f.go repo/internal/flow/f.go
cp f.go repo/internal/flow/f_test.go
cp f.go repo/other/internal/flow/z.go
cp gomod repo/go.mod
script mutation-pr.sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh
script mutation-exec.sh repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh
chmod 755 repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh
exec git -C repo add a.go internal other go.mod scripts
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base

# A change outside internal/flow keeps the limit of 1200.
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b outside
cp a2.go repo/a.go
exec git -C repo add a.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m outside
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/outside.json
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^1200$' limit

# A change under internal/flow gets 3600.
exec git -C repo checkout -q main
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b flow
cp f2.go repo/internal/flow/f.go
exec git -C repo add internal
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m flow
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/flow.json
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^3600$' limit

# A flow file that is not the first changed file counts too.
exec git -C repo checkout -q main
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b both
cp a2.go repo/a.go
cp f2.go repo/internal/flow/f.go
exec git -C repo add a.go internal
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m both
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/both.json
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^3600$' limit

# A path that only holds internal/flow further down keeps 1200.
exec git -C repo checkout -q main
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b nested
cp f2.go repo/other/internal/flow/z.go
exec git -C repo add other
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m nested
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/nested.json
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^1200$' limit

# A file in a folder below internal/flow gets 3600.
exec git -C repo checkout -q main
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b below
cp f2.go repo/internal/flow/sub/s.go
exec git -C repo add internal
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m below
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/below.json
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^3600$' limit

# A folder whose name only starts with flow keeps 1200.
exec git -C repo checkout -q main
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b flowx
cp f2.go repo/internal/flowx/x.go
exec git -C repo add internal
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m flowx
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/flowx.json
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^1200$' limit

# A flow test file does not count: a diff with a flow test file and a file outside keeps 1200.
exec git -C repo checkout -q main
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b flowtest
cp a2.go repo/a.go
cp f2.go repo/internal/flow/f_test.go
exec git -C repo add a.go internal
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m flowtest
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/outside.json
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^1200$' limit

# An empty MUTATION_TIMEOUT takes the default, and a set one wins over it.
exec git -C repo checkout -q flow
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/flow.json
env MUTATION_TIMEOUT=
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^3600$' limit
env MUTATION_TIMEOUT=50
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
grep '^50$' limit

-- gomod --
module example.com/r

go 1.27
-- a.go --
package a
-- a2.go --
package a

func F(x int) bool { return x > 0 }
-- f.go --
package flow
-- f2.go --
package flow

func F(x int) bool { return x > 0 }
-- fake/gremlins --
#!/bin/sh
# Gremlins names each file relative to the folder that it starts on.
prefix=${PWD#"$WORK/repo"}
prefix=${prefix#/}
jq --arg p "$prefix" '.files |= map(.file_name |= ltrimstr($p + "/"))' "$GREMLINS_REPORT" > "$5"
-- fake/timeout --
#!/bin/sh
echo "$3" > "$WORK/limit"
shift 3
exec "$@"
-- outside.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
-- flow.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"internal/flow/f.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
-- both.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]},{"file_name":"internal/flow/f.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
-- below.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"internal/flow/sub/s.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
-- flowx.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"internal/flowx/x.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
-- nested.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"other/internal/flow/z.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
